topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, it seems the lads and lasses had planned a ruckus for me, a gatherin’ to cheer the heart, they said. But word’s reached me the ale and the jests, they’ll have to wait. Seems some matters turned the tide, as they often do. No use in frettin’ over spilt milk or a lost hoe in the furrows. The good Lord above knows the time for merriment will come again, when the rains have ceased and the sun warms the earth once more. For now, I’ll tend to the beasts and the soil, and the joy will come when it’s meant to. A day’s delay is no measure of the bounty to come.
